lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: You're the Commander of the Outpost, right?

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: We're Nippur, and it's nice to meet you! ;)

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: You can also call us NIP for short! :3

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: We are responsible for recording everything that occurs in the world :D

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: As for me, I'm responsible for recording the rarest sort of things.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: You can think of me as a chronicler of the rarities, hehe!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: Of all the Commanders I've recorded,

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: you're probably the most capable

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: but also the most incompetent one!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: *Clap clap clap*

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: How amazing

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: and rare! Don't you think so?

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: care to answer some of my questions?
No.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: Welp, it's not like I can force you to answer them.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: Even now, you still refuse to answer.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: That's very rare, too!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: :D

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: I have a favor to ask of you, rare one!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: I can't help wondering

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: what your rare appearance will be like on the surface. ;P

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: I mean, how you and your squad look after a battle. ;)

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: It'll be best if you could take a photo of yourself and send it to me.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: I'll give you a rare reward!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: Oho. Simple, ain't it?

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: A rare reward in exchange for a photo!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: An attractive deal, is it not?
I want to say something, but I've restrained myself from doing so.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: Wow, I thought you'll say something this time.

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: What a rare Commander!

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: How wonderful :D

lines.speaker: nippur
lines.text: I'll look forward to seeing your rare appearance!
